assertions.name: SDP shadow price predicts temperatures far above empirical

description: Boiling points from the q-ideal gas law with the antisymmetric (directional H-bond) channel weight y0* = W_(1,1)(q0) in place of the h2-suppressed cohesion of the sibling scan. Yields temperatures of order 10^4 K, showing that a purely structural map from P_q V_q = n_q R T requires a much larger entropic/topological denominator dS_vap than the bare [2]_q. Scope-(a): this constrains the magnitude of dS_vap; it excludes neither the antisymmetric channel nor the q-ideal gas law. NOTE: the original witness framed y0* as an SDP LP-dual shadow price; that SDP is not recoverable and is NOT reconstructed here (see the module docstring). y0* is computed from the documented closed form, which matches the recorded value to all 16 serialized digits.

data.y0_star_provenance: closed form W_(1,1)(q) = (q^3+q^2-q^{3/2})/(q^3+q^2+q+1); docs/audits/2026-06-01-inter-nucleon-linked-channel.md. NOT an SDP solve, and NOT y_(1,1) (= 0.2473 at q0, a different weight family).
data.finding: Substituting the antisymmetric channel weight for h2 makes the over-prediction worse, not better: ~30-45x observed rather than 6-10x. A derived topological factor for dS_vap is required. No fit applied. Status remains OPEN.
